correctness.rationale: For fixed L and positive wall stiffnesses the confining reversible generator has compact resolvent. The first excited eigenfunction is the unique one-node Sturm solution. Square-integrable Gaussian exterior eigenfunctions produce exact gamma-function logarithmic derivatives; matching at both endpoints yields kL+arctan r_-+arctan r_+=pi. Expanding the gamma quotient and phase determines the positive B, the exact Z_T, and an O(T^3) remainder. Numerical checker independently evaluated origin derivatives and roots with 125 passed assertions; it is diagnostic, not proof.

value.rationale: The recent probability paper poses sharp small-noise relaxation questions for a flat convex well. The leading reflected-Brownian spectral scale misses physically meaningful boundary penetration. The exact partition function predicts the eigenvalue through T^2, but a universal strictly negative T^(5/2) correction, with explicit unequal-stiffness dependence, marks its first failure. This is a motivated structural boundary-layer law for a natural stochastic generator, not a numerical slice or normalization check.
